scope: source-map-js is dev-only via Vite 7.3.6 and PostCSS 8.5.28; the relevant input is a source map processed during frontend development/build, not an Observer API request.

The bounded regression constructs a consumer through actual PostCSS for an indexed map with line offset 10,000,001; it never expands or serializes the large mapping. Old package accepts it, patched package rejects it.
rustls is used for outbound TLS. Existing resolved feature tree is unchanged: ring, std, tls12; no features, certificate trust settings, or application configuration were changed.
The rustls release fixes conditional vulnerabilities; the patch does not claim all advisories are exploitable in this application configuration.
